reason: NONE. The first thing I saw was "200 mg" on the front, and it's two capsules per sachet, which is exactly the trick I look for. At 100 mg of elemental magnesium per capsule from bisglycinate, those capsules have to be big, and I leave bad reviews on big capsules. A new brand with zero reviews at $29.99 is also a hard sell when I can compare price per serving.
objection: Two big capsules a day, and nothing tells me the capsule size. No reviews yet, and $1 a serving is steep for an unknown brand.
would_change_my_mind: A clearly stated small capsule size, or a powder option, plus a few dozen real reviews from people who say the capsules are easy to swallow.
